_what: Files the engine produced or read that are deliberately NOT committed (owner decision D-034, 2026-10-21: no full historical data exports and no per-fight data in the repository). Each is identified by sha256, so a copy obtained elsewhere can be verified byte for byte. cfl_discovery.ledger.verify accepts a ledger-recorded file that is absent only when it is listed here with the same sha256; a file that is present must still match. Real-data runs add their per-fight predictions here automatically.
how_to_obtain: Re-export: run research/discovery/export_dev.sql read-only against the database (every statement filters event_date < 2025-01-01) and save the two outputs as data/dev/fights.csv and data/dev/fighters.csv. The loader refuses a file whose priced subset does not reproduce PRED-001's frozen DEV fingerprints.

Or, while the original research branch exists (it has not been deleted, but deleting it is an owner decision), take the exact bytes from its commit: git show <source_commit>:<source_path>. The blob id below identifies the same bytes in any clone that has them.
Per-fight predictions (oos_predictions.csv) are regenerated by rerunning the run's config on the verified data; the consolidation audit reproduced ledger entry 1 byte for byte.

data/dev/fights.csv.why: full DEV export: UFCStats per-fight totals and BFO opening and closing consensus prices

data/dev/fighters.csv.why: fighter profile values including dates of birth

runs/20261021T200151Z-phase1/oos_predict.why: per-fight market probabilities, model probabilities and results
